text: Stable file readers shape-shifting data sources. external data depend changes shape — columns renamed, types swapped, layouts flipped — code reads files breaks. crate one place knows shape variations. Call crt_ingest("source", "file_name", path) anywhere. call, output, regardless version upstream file landed. upstream changes shape , fix crate; everywhere downstream keeps working.

title: Canonical Schema and Data Governance for New Graph Environment
text: call crt_ingest("bcfp", "user_habitat_classification", path), five pieces wire together runtime: Registry (inst/extdata/crate_registry.csv) — CSV mapping (source, file_name) pair handler function name schema YAML path. crate looks “know file?” . Loaded crt_registry_load(). Schema YAML (inst/extdata/schemas/bcfp/user_habitat_classification.yaml) — declares canonical column shape (names, types, required flags) known upstream variant (column-name set + normalize-function id). Loaded crt_schema_read(). Handler (R/crt_handler_bcfp_user_habitat_classification.R) — one function per (source, file_name). crate matches actual file columns variant’s declared columns (first set-equal match wins), dispatches matched variant_id handler: 2026-04-26-wide → identity passthrough (already canonical) pre-2026-04-26-long → pivot long rows wide canonical, mapping habitat_ind text values integer indicators Validation (crt_schema_validate()) — handler returns, crate checks every column declared required: true schema present. Fails loud listing missing required columns. Type enforcement (crt_schema_apply()) — finally, crate coerces every named column type declared schema (integer, double, string, logical). Schema YAML single source truth types; handlers don’t encode type knowledge. Without , readr’s defaults leak (integer cols become double, declared strings become Date). handler made type change transparent example. wide canonical declares spawning rearing integer columns; long upstream habitat_ind text ("t"/"f"). pivot text→integer conversion step long→wide reshape — callers never see either intermediate form. Type enforcement (step 5) catches leaks boundary regardless handler.

title: Canonical Schema and Data Governance for New Graph Environment
text: Every function crate’s namespace starts crt_, family-namespaced: crt_<verb> — public singletons (crt_ingest, crt_files) crt_handler_<source>_<file_name> — per-(source, file) dispatchers crt_<family>_<verb> — internal helper families (crt_registry_*, crt_schema_*) Reserved future families (slots crt_schema_* family schema--contract roadmap): crt_schema_version, crt_schema_migrate, plus future cols[].range, cols[].enum, cols[].predicate extensions crt_schema_validate.

what: Caveat: variant matching is column-names only
title: Canonical Schema and Data Governance for New Graph Environment
text: crt_ingest() matches input upstream variants exact column-name set equality. validate column types variant-match step. upstream later ships column names different types, handler receive misshapen data; crt_schema_apply() coerces output (coercions silently produce NAs, e.g., .integer("yes") → NA). Type-aware variant matching (declaring cols: [{name, type}] validating dispatch) planned v0.1.x improvement. Output types required-cols enforced via crt_schema_apply() crt_schema_validate() respectively (steps 4–5 ).

title: Validate a data frame against a schema's canonical column declarations — crt_schema_validate
text: Called crt_ingest() handler dispatch crt_schema_apply() — validate shape first (fail loud missing required cols), coerce types second. Without validation , missing required column silently become NA .integer(NULL)-style coercion type-apply step; surfaces failure right layer. Lives crt_schema_* family alongside crt_schema_apply() crt_schema_read(). Future extensions (reserved family slots; v0.0.2): cols[].range numeric range checks cols[].enum value-membership checks cols[].predicate custom predicate function refs lands additional cli::cli_abort branches function schema YAML grows corresponding declaration keys. function signature change — schema YAML drives behavior.

title: crate 0.0.2 (2026-04-29)
text: Schema--contract scope settled Convention C naming locked (see crate#4). Every function crate namespace now prefixed crt_*, family-namespaced (crt_schema_*, crt_registry_*, crt_handler_*). New crt_schema_* family: crt_schema_read() (load YAML relative path), crt_schema_apply() (canonical type enforcement), crt_schema_validate() (required-cols enforcement). crt_ingest() now validates required cols enforces canonical types handler dispatch — schema YAML single source truth.
